reassessment_reason: Reconfirmed the publisher-designated paid Corporate File and narrowed schema uncertainty to code values and record encoding, rather than claiming no layout exists.

candidate.publisher: Maryland SDAT through its designated contractor SpecPrint
candidate.price: Published $2,100 per Corporate File; weekly subscription quote unresolved

access.bulk: SDAT identifies a historical domestic/foreign entity file sold through SpecPrint, with monthly master creation and a weekly subscription option.
access.api: Reviewed official material establishes a file product, not an anonymous bulk API.
access.automation: FTP is preferred delivery; unattended retrieval permission and credentials remain unestablished.

fields.summary: The 25-table positional layout defines BUSENTIT, BUSADDRE and ENTITYST. ID_BUS_PREFIX plus ID_BUS CHAR 16 appears as a key; CD_ADDRESS_TYPE lacks a value dictionary. ENTITYST defines FL_ACTIVE but not its allowed values. VARCHAR and binary-looking numeric positions require an encoding contract.

active_status_semantics: A declared FL_ACTIVE column is insufficient to select current entities until code values and joins are confirmed. Registry status is not evidence of current operation.
statewide_completeness: SDAT describes corporations active since 1982 and other entity families. SpecPrint labels 9,300,000 average weekly records without a unique-entity definition; it is not a completion denominator.
address_zip: BUSADDRE declares AD_ZIP CHAR 9, plus address-type and email fields. Address-role codes must be confirmed before excluding agent/person addresses. ZIP5 and ZIP4 must remain separate in normalized outputs; no postal deliverability or physical-site proof is established.
automation_terms_fees: SpecPrint requires advance payment; selected listings require a signed order form. No order, payment, login or source records were requested.
redistribution: Publisher designation confirms the sales channel, not downstream retention, transformation, geocoding or redistribution rights. Those remain contract questions.
temporal_refresh: Monthly creation and weekly subscription do not establish full-versus-delta delivery, delete/correction handling, checksums or replay. The layout has no reviewed version/date or compatibility promise.

citations.evidence: SDAT designates SpecPrint, describes historical scope and principal/agent fields, monthly creation and weekly subscription.
Designated publisher contractor lists Corporate File price, average weekly record count, FTP preference and payment conditions.
Seven-page 25-table layout contains public field positions but no address/status value dictionary or encoding specification.

strongest_next_action: Prepare a document-only request to SDAT/SpecPrint for current unsigned terms, subscription quote, codebooks, encoding and ID mapping, aggregate byte sizes, and baseline/update/checksum/replay contract. Separate authorization is required before contact or purchase.
